story.title: Laid-off Oracle workers denied better severance as remote classification strips WARN Act rights
story.summary: Laid-off Oracle employees who attempted to negotiate improved severance packages were rebuffed by the company, which also classified many of them as remote workers — a designation that can disqualify them from WARN Act protections requiring 60 days' advance notice of mass layoffs. The situation highlights a legal grey area that tech companies may increasingly exploit as AI-driven restructuring accelerates. Workers' advocates say the remote-classification tactic effectively strips a meaningful safety net from employees at one of the world's largest enterprise software firms.
